propositions: The outbound differ compares in vendor shape (raw Jira snapshot keys) while the inbound differ canonicalizes via InboundMapper, creating an asymmetry that violates the port seam principle.

The outbound update path must canonicalize the remote snapshot entry using the injected InboundMapper before comparison and emit vendor payloads only via OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote at the emission boundary.

InboundMapper output must be widened with three canonical alias keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) that encode identity-match and parent information in neutral shape, replacing vendor-specific field extraction.

The stored baseline remains vendor-shaped at rest (opaque); canonicalization occurs only at read time via InboundMapper, which must tolerate partial _BASELINE_FIELDS dicts by emitting only keys whose source vendor key is present.

The assignee resolver and _assignee_is_account_id sentinel are re-homed to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee (parameterized only on canonical assignee_identity), preserving the three-state contract and downstream dispatch pipeline unchanged.
Outbound vendor-key literals and adapters.jira imports must be eliminated from outbound_differ.py; _diff_fields and related helpers become adapter-internal.
